description: Use this skill when a user needs to inspect or diagnose Apache HTTP Server, verify config syntax, inspect parsed virtual hosts and modules, read configured mod_status metrics, an error log or access-log status summary, or perform a guarded graceful reload. It requires local apachectl access.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
